name: newms-plugins
description: Personal plugin set: discipline, dev pipeline, danxbot orchestration, issue-worker autonomy

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Universal discipline: bash exit capture, sub-agent delegation, tool usage, process kill, monitor polling. Install everywhere.

plugins.name: investigate
plugins.description: Read-only investigation methodology. Hypothesis → evidence → findings → options. NEVER applies fixes. For diagnostic agents (slack, dashboards, dev sessions before fix-writing).

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Code-writing discipline: TDD, debugging-with-fix, code quality, git safety. Install on instances that write code.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Human-in-loop dev pipeline: flow-* skills, plan mode, collaboration. NOT for autonomous dispatched agents.

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Issue card workflow: YAML schema, tracker contract, danx-issue MCP usage. Install where cards are read or written.

plugins.name: danxbot
plugins.description: Danxbot orchestrator domain knowledge: dispatch architecture, runtime modes, deploy. Install on danxbot-aware instances.

plugins.name: issue-worker
plugins.description: Autonomous issue-worker workflow: danx-start, danx-next, danx-ideate, danx-triage, danx-epic-link. Workspace-only.
